about.title: GDC: Jewels that Create Emotions
about.subtitle: A tradition of craftsmanship, a passion for perfection.
about.paragraph1: GDC was born from a mix of deep passion for craftsmanship, jewelry, and the ability to create unique objects, and the passion for seeing people get emotional thanks to a jewel made with my own hands. The real push to found this laboratory was not just my passion but the awareness of the emotional impact of the work done. It all began with an unexpected moment: the delivery of a custom-made ring, where the client's emotion was so intense that it translated into tears of joy.
about.paragraph2: This episode transformed a passion into a mission. GDC does not sell precious items, but creates feelings translated into gold and precious gems, works destined to become part of your emotional heritage.

section1.title: Mastery, Transparency, and Dedication
section1.text: After years of training and over 10 years of work and refinement in goldsmithing techniques, I have developed my expertise.

section2.title: Your Jewel, Your Story
section2.text: Whether you want an engagement ring created from scratch or the revision of a family heirloom, GDC offers you a unique piece, built with dedication and destined to become part of your emotional heritage.

hero.title: The jewel you have in mind, handcrafted for you
hero.subtitle: Every piece starts with a conversation: tell us your idea — a sketch, a photo, or even just a feeling — and we’ll turn it into a one-of-a-kind jewel made for you. Consultation and quote are always free, with no obligation.
hero.whatsappPrefill: Hello! I’d like information about a custom jewel.

steps.label: How it works
steps.title: From desire to jewel, in 4 steps

1.title: Free consultation
1.text: Tell us your idea: a sketch, a photo, or even just a feeling. We listen, advise you on materials and stones, and find the right direction together. No obligation.

2.title: Design and drawing
2.text: We turn the idea into a concrete design, with measurements, materials and a detailed quote. Nothing is made without your approval.

3.title: Handcrafted creation
3.text: The jewel takes shape in our workshop, handcrafted with care in every detail. We keep you updated on the progress.

4.title: Delivery
4.text: Final quality check and delivery of your unique piece, ready to wear or to gift.

why.label: Why custom
why.title: A standard jewel will never be yours like this one

1.title: Truly unique
1.text: No one else in the world will own an identical piece: design, proportions and details are born from your story.

2.title: Perfect fit
2.text: Measurements designed for you — finger, wrist, neck: the jewel adapts to its wearer, not the other way around.

3.title: A budget made to measure
3.text: 18kt gold, silver or different stones: we build the project around your budget, with a clear quote before we start.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Everything you want to know
faq.q1: How long does it take to create a custom jewel?
faq.a1: It depends on the complexity of the project: generally, from the approved design to delivery it takes a few weeks. For special occasions (weddings, anniversaries, births) we recommend contacting us in advance, so we can plan the timing together without rushing.
faq.q2: Which materials do you use? Is the gold guaranteed?
faq.a2: We mainly work with 18kt gold (yellow, white and rose), 925 silver and platinum, with selected natural stones. The gold fineness is guaranteed and hallmarked in accordance with current regulations.
faq.q3: Can I change the design before it is made?
faq.a3: Yes, absolutely. The project is defined together with you and nothing is made without your approval of the design and the quote. Even during crafting, whenever possible, we welcome the changes you ask for.
faq.q4: Are the consultation and the quote free?
faq.a4: Yes: the initial consultation and the quote are always free and without obligation.
faq.q5: Can I have a jewel I already own transformed?
faq.a5: Yes: we restore and transform existing or family jewels, giving new life to pieces you care about. Tell us what you have in mind and we’ll find the best solution together.

cta.title: Your idea deserves to become a jewel
cta.subtitle: Fill out the form in a few minutes: we’ll get back to you with a free, no-obligation quote.
cta.note: Prefer to talk? Call us or message us on WhatsApp: we usually reply within 24 hours.

orders.title: How to Order
orders.subtitle: Every GDC piece is made to order. Here is how it works, step by step.

steps.title: 1. Choose your jewel
steps.text: Browse the gallery or design a one-of-a-kind piece in the Create Jewel section.

steps.title: 2. Send us your request
steps.text: Fill in the contact form or the custom order form: we will reply with a quote and timelines.

steps.title: 3. Confirmation and crafting
steps.text: Once you confirm, your jewel is handcrafted in our laboratory.

steps.title: 4. Delivery
steps.text: We keep you updated on progress until the finished piece is delivered.
